name: Lithium 7 Beta
body: ## Lithium 7 Beta (pre-release) v7.1.06.13.25 [](https://discord.gg/3zbfaTNN7V) This is a very early beta release of Lithium 7, complete with kernel & ramdisk, with built-in Xposed support. It has achieved a record-setting boot time of just _40 seconds_, as opposed to the 1:04 boot time of Lithium 5. If you have any issues, feel free to join the **[discussion](https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/discussions)**, or join the **[Discord server](https://discord.gg/3zbfaTNN7V)**. We recommend joining for updates, and even to just to hang out with the community - we even have our own Minecraft server! [](https://discord.gg/3zbfaTNN7V) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/commits/Lithium-7 ## What's Changed * Updated initial boot logo * Added scatter file within flashing package * Attempted speaker audio fix, but speaker still does not work #### A massive thank you to **Meowing Kibble** for the new initial boot logo, and for other contributions (and for working on the speaker issue)!

name: Lithium 7 Kernel v7.1.06.09.25
body: ## Lithium 7 Kernel v7.1.06.09.25 [](https://discord.gg/3zbfaTNN7V) This is a first official release of the Lithium 7 Android kernel & ramdisk, with built-in Xposed support. You can use this kernel with _some_ other Android 7 ROMs for Timmkoo devices, and you are welcome to modify the kernel and contribute with any changes. If you have any issues, feel free to join the **[discussion](https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/discussions)**, or join the **[Discord server](https://discord.gg/3zbfaTNN7V)**. [](https://discord.gg/3zbfaTNN7V) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/commits/Kernel ## What's Changed * Added Discord badge to ReadMe. by @NoahDomingues in https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/pull/4 * Update SECURITY.MD by @ItsNoahDomingues in https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/pull/5 ## New Contributors * @NoahDomingues made their first contribution in https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/pull/4 * @ItsNoahDomingues made their first contribution in https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/pull/5 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/compare/Kernel...Kernel-v7.1.06.09.25 This project, and this particular ROM, was made possible entirely with the efforts of **[Palutenfan123](https://github.com/timmkoo)**. It was his discovery and his work that brought this into existence; therefore, he deserves full credit for it. Also thanks to him for providing the hosting services for our [website](https://lithium.timmkoo.de). He maintains his own custom ROM, called T-ROM, available [here](https://timmkoo.de).

name: Lithium 5 Kernel Beta v0.06.04.25
body: ## Lithium 5 Kernel Beta v0.06.04.25 This is a beta release of the Lithium 5 Android kernel & ramdisk, with built-in Magisk support. You can use this kernel with any other Android 5 ROM for Timmkoo devices, and you are welcome to modify the kernel and contribute with any changes. If you have any issues, feel free to join the **[discussion](https://github.com/NoahDomingues/Lithium/discussions)**, or join the **[Discord server](https://discord.gg/3zbfaTNN7V)**.
